scenario: Player idle at Kawasaki Shrine / Kawasaki Village, no movement or combat

tools: Temporary client settings and scene isolation
Temporary server anchoring and network ownership inspection
methodology.movement: Every completed run reported zero player position displacement
methodology.foreground: User confirmed Studio in foreground before foreground_* and pairedLights_* runs
methodology.controlledComparison: For foreground comparisons, all 12 export trunks were anchored and ClockTime fixed to 15.740833. Each scenario warmed up for 1–1.5 seconds before sampling.
limits: Roblox Studio runs client, server and editor in the same process; absolute FPS is not a published-client or mobile benchmark.
Several exploratory runs became background-throttled or unstable and were excluded from causal FPS ranking.
foreground_noSmartBone and foreground_baseline_B had rare 400+ ms stalls; their means are not reliable steady-state comparisons.
CPU render, physics and GPU times can overlap and must not be added into frame time.
MicroProfiler scopes are inclusive; parallel worker totals are not critical-path wall time.
SmartBone contains unmatched profiling begin/end in skip branches; avoided ranking it by summed scope duration.
Triangle totals exclude Shadows; pass composition is view-dependent.
Stored MicroProfiler summaries, not raw binary capture files.

findings.evidence: All 12 imported templates were unanchored. Multiple parts kept moving and colliding while player was idle. Ten parts were owned by the local player and two by server.
findings.recommendation: Keep export-only templates anchored outside active gameplay, preferably in ServerStorage when not used by the client.

findings.evidence: 2025 ocean bones updated by RenderStepped, eight wave components. Plane-frustum visibility does not test scene occlusion. MicroProfiler measured Script_Waves about 2.31 ms per invocation in the focused capture.
findings.recommendation: Reduce or suspend ocean deformation while occluded/inland and apply distance/frequency LOD.

findings.evidence: Eight fully transparent light-holder parts, each with an enabled PointLight and shadows. Two are approximately 13 studs from the camera with overlapping ranges.
findings.recommendation: Review overlap, distance and daytime activation of these local lights; preserve only lighting that changes the scene meaningfully.

findings.evidence: About 3.06 million triangles and 1190 draw calls excluding Shadows in this viewpoint. Opaque geometry about 2.55 million triangles; terrain grass about 294505.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize visible opaque geometry, reuse materials/meshes and distance LOD. In the current session Ores contained no BaseParts, so previous ore findings were not reused.

findings.evidence: No active screen effects (only BowProjectiles folder in workspace.VFX). WindShake measured about 0.163 ms per frame; humanoid and animation scopes about 0.36 and 0.35 ms per frame in focused snapshot. Combat AI runners were all disabled.

UpdateDistance schedules Refresh every second, even when player stays still; Refresh enumerates tagged roots and sorts eligible meshes. Possible idle work reduction, not isolated as a leading bottleneck.

validation.temporaryChanges: All changes confined to playtest instances/settings; restored and playtest stopped.
